name: Feature request

**v1 scope is intentionally narrow.** OpenTCM v1 is for **authoring and
organizing test cases** on a closed network. Please read the
[README roadmap](https://github.com/shanecookofficial/open-tc-manager#roadmap-not-in-v1)
before filing. These themes are **explicitly out of v1** and will be closed with
a pointer to that list:

1. Users and per-case change history
2. Test result reporting (manual and automated)
3. Search by step text
4. Import / export
5. Test case version control

Also out of v1: authentication, integrations, webhooks, attachments, tags, and
custom fields (`docs/PLAN.md` §2).

**Problem**

What is painful today?

**Proposed solution**

How should it work?

**Why this belongs in v1 (if it does)**

If it is a bug, polish, or a gap in the shipped authoring/trash workflow, say
so. If it is a roadmap item, please wait for a later version rather than opening
an implementation PR.
